0022600142.text: The Dallas Mavericks (1-2, 4th in the Southwest and 12th in the West, currently on a one-game losing streak) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West, on a three-game winning streak). Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, but the Mavericks lost 0-3 to the Thunder in the 2025-26 season series and most recently fell 100-87 to them in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
